extracted.name: Chili Cheese Dip from Hormel Chili
extracted.description: This Hormel chili cheese dip is easy to make in the microwave. Serve warm with corn chips for a deliciously cheesy football snack guaranteed to please!
ingredient_lines: 1 (16 ounce) package processed cheese food (such as Velveeta®), cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1 (15 ounce) can HORMEL® Chili No Beans
instruction_lines: Combine cheese cubes and chili in a microwave-safe bowl. Cover and microwave on high, stirring once, until cheese is melted and mixture is hot, 4 ½ to 5 minutes. Serve warm.
